q: Life would be tragic if it weren't funny.
Ponder and deliberate before you make a move.
Love your enemies, for they tell you your faults.
Help others and give something back.
None are more hopelessly enslaved than those who falsely believe they are free.
Trying to define yourself is like trying to bite your own teeth.
The fact of the matter is that there will be nothing learned from any challenge in which we don't try our hardest.
As soon as you truly commit to making something happen, the 'how' will reveal itself.
It is better to disappoint people with the truth than to appease them with a lie.
The first man gets the oyster, the second man gets the shell.
Awaken. Take heed, do not squander your life.
Getting lost along your path is a part of finding the path you are meant to be on.
Death is not sad; the sad thing is that most people don't really live at all.
Where there is no struggle, there is no strength.
What most people need to learn in life is how to love people and use things instead of using people and loving things.
You drown not by falling into a river, but by staying submerged in it.
The most courageous act is still to think for yourself. Aloud.
Cherish forever what makes you unique, cuz you're really a yawn if it goes.
Be brave enough to suck at something new.
The smallest act of kindness is worth more than the greatest intention.
Hope means hoping when everything seems hopeless.
Sometimes you have to travel a long way to find what is near.
Always seek out the seed of triumph in every adversity.
Change yourself - you are in control.
The wise warrior avoids the battle.
Darkness is the absence of light.
Art is the signature of civilizations.
Pursue what catches your heart, not what catches your eyes.
Everything will be ok in the end. If it's not ok, it's not the end.
A strong team can take any crazy vision and turn it into reality.
Happiness is a choice, not a result. Nothing will make you happy until you choose to be happy.
Saying nothing sometimes says the most.
The more you are grateful for what you have the more you will have to be grateful for.
We are shaped and fashioned by what we love.
Don't let making a living prevent you from making a life.
When your intuition is strong, follow it.
The meaning of life is to find your gift. The purpose of life is to give it away.
Your mind will make you rich or poor, depending on the use you put to it.
Treat every moment as your last. It is not preparation for something else.
Where does a thought go when it's forgotten?
Opportunities don't often come along. So, when they do, you have to grab them.
To the world you may be one person; but to one person you may be the world.
The secret to happiness is having low expectations.
The way to move out of judgement is to move into gratitude.
Strategy is a commodity, execution is an art.
Success is not to be pursued, it is to be attracted by the person you become.
Do all things with love.
The only time you run out of chances is when you stop taking them.
Being ignorant is not so much a shame, as being unwilling to learn.
Wherever you are, and whatever you do, be in love.
